title: Pure Metaphys
summary: Pure Metaphys banish and delay-trigger control deck with generic staples. Metaphys monsters are LIGHT Wyrms that trigger delayed search, summon, and deck-banishing effects during the Standby Phase after being banished, unleashing devastating board-wiping effects when Special Summoned by a Metaphys monster's effect.

summary.title: Starters
points: Metaphys Ragnarok banishes the top three cards of your Deck upon Normal or Special Summon, and Special Summons a Level 5 or higher Metaphys monster from your Deck when it inflicts battle damage.
Metaphys Factor allows you to Normal Summon a Level 5 or higher Metaphys monster once per turn without Tributing, and prevents opponent card activations when your Metaphys card effects activate.
Asymmetaphys allows you to banish one Metaphys card from your hand once per turn to draw one card, kickstarting the archetype's banish loop.
Metaphys Ascension discards a Metaphys card to draw one card and banish a Metaphys monster from your Deck; when banished itself, it adds any Metaphys card from Deck to hand.

summary.title: Opening: Metaphys Factor + Metaphys Ragnarok + Asymmetaphys
steps: Activate Metaphys Factor, preventing opponent responses to Metaphys activations.
Activate Asymmetaphys and use its ignition effect to banish Metaphys Nephthys from your hand to draw one card.
Normal Summon Metaphys Ragnarok, triggering its effect to banish the top three cards of your Deck to mill additional Metaphys cards.
Set Metaphys Ascension or Metaphys Dimension to prepare interaction for the opponent's turn.

During the next Standby Phase, banished Metaphys Nephthys shuffles itself into the Deck to search any Metaphys card, while other banished Metaphys monsters trigger to banish from Deck or Special Summon from hand.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Metaphys Daedalus banishes all other face-up Special Summoned monsters on the field if Special Summoned by the effect of a Metaphys monster, and during the Standby Phase after being banished, shuffles into the Deck to banish a Metaphys card from the Deck.

Metaphys Nephthys banishes all Set Spells and Traps on the field if Special Summoned by the effect of a Metaphys monster, and shuffles into the Deck during the Standby Phase after being banished to search a Metaphys card.

Metaphys Tyrant Dragon is unaffected by Trap effects, can attack monsters twice, and shuffles into the Deck during the Standby Phase after being banished to Special Summon a Metaphys monster from your hand.

Metaphys Horus is a Level 6 Synchro whose effects scale based on materials: gaining effect immunity from Normal Monsters like Metaphys Armed Dragon, negating a face-up card from Effect Monsters, and permanently stealing an opponent's monster from Pendulums like Metaphys Decoy Dragon.

Metaphys Executor is summoned by banishing five Metaphys cards with different names from your field or GY; it cannot be destroyed or banished by card effects and revives a banished Metaphys when the opponent activates an effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Metaphys Factor enables high-Level Normal Summons without Tributing and protects Metaphys effect activations from being responded to.
Asymmetaphys cycles cards, debuffs non-Metaphys monsters' ATK/DEF, and changes battle positions whenever a Metaphys card is banished.
Metaphys Ascension discards to draw, banishes a Metaphys from the Deck, and searches a Metaphys card when banished.
Metaphys Dimension Special Summons a banished Metaphys monster when your opponent Special Summons a monster, and banishes a card on the field once per turn when a Metaphys card is banished.
